record.original_question: Given a graph together with its eigenvalues and eigenspaces, provide necessary and sufficient conditions for instantaneous uniform mixing to occur, where instantaneous uniform mixing means that at some time t all entries of U(t) have the same absolute value, equivalently all entries of the mixing matrix M(t) = U(t) o U(-t) are equal.

evidence.quote: In general, it would be enlightening to give a characterisation of instantaneous uniform mixing which does not depend on the time.
3.3 Open Problem. Given the eigenvalues and eigenspaces of a graph, give necessary and sufficient conditions for uniform mixing to occur.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a finite simple graph with adjacency matrix $A$, and consider the continuous-time quantum walk with transition operator
$$U(t) = \exp(itA), \qquad t \in \mathbb{R}.$$
Define the mixing matrix
$$M(t) = U(t) \circ \overline{U(t)} = U(t) \circ U(-t),$$
where $\circ$ denotes the entrywise (Hadamard) product. The graph $X$ is said to admit instantaneous uniform mixing if there exists $t \in \mathbb{R}$ such that all entries of $M(t)$ are equal, equivalently, all entries of $U(t)$ have the same absolute value $1/\sqrt{|V(X)|}$.

Let $A = \sum_{r} \theta_r E_r$ be the spectral decomposition of $A$, where $\theta_r$ are the distinct eigenvalues and $E_r$ are the orthogonal projections onto the corresponding eigenspaces.

Problem: Given only the eigenvalues $\{\theta_r\}$ and eigenspace projections $\{E_r\}$ of $X$, give necessary and sufficient conditions (independent of the time $t$) for $X$ to admit instantaneous uniform mixing.
artifact.category_tag: Quantum walks on graphs / uniform mixing
artifact.status_search_result: A general spectral characterization of instantaneous uniform mixing remains open. Complete classifications are only known in special families (e.g., strongly regular graphs with parameters $(4m^2, 2m^2 \pm m, m^2 \pm m, m^2 \pm m)$, certain Cayley graphs, hypercubes, and Cartesian powers of $K_{1,3}$). Recent work continues to study $\epsilon$-uniform mixing and add new examples, but no time-independent eigenvalue/eigenspace characterization of uniform mixing for arbitrary graphs has been established.

status_evidence.title: ϵ-Uniform Mixing in Discrete Quantum Walks
status_evidence.snippet: Studies approximate uniform mixing on regular graphs in terms of adjacency eigenvalues and eigenprojections, indicating the exact characterization is still being developed.
status_evidence.claim: A complete spectral characterization remains an active research topic, supporting open status.

status_evidence.title: Uniform Mixing on Cayley Graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Provides characterizations only for restricted Cayley graph classes, leaving the general problem open.
status_evidence.claim: Only special-case characterizations exist; the general problem is open.

status_evidence.title: Uniform Mixing and Association Schemes
status_evidence.snippet: Classifies uniform mixing in special strongly regular and association scheme settings.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results exist for structured graph families but not in general.
